sections.chapter_title: General-purpose and alternate-function I/Os (GPIOs and AFIOs)
sections.text_helper: Section 9.3.5 "JTAG/SWD alternate function remapping" in chapter 9 (General-purpose and alternate-function I/Os (GPIOs and AFIOs)), RM0008 Rev 21, page 176.
sections.section_content:
The debug interface signals are mapped on the GPIO ports as shown in Table36.
[Table 36. Debug interface signals]
To optimize the number of free GPIOs during debugging, this mapping can be configured in
different ways by programming the SWJ_CFG[1:0] bits in the AF remap and debug I/O
configuration register (AFIO_MAPR). Refer to Table37.
[Table 37. Debug port mapping]
